The new block loops over `("metrics", "metrics_secondary")` and calls `self._assign_uuids_to_metrics(stored, seen=self._collect_saved_metric_uuids(...))`. Neither helper's body is shown. I also can't confirm it returns a new list rather than mutating `stored` in place. In-place mutation would make `deduped != stored` false, so nothing would be persisted. The patch only writes `update_data[field] = deduped` when `deduped != stored`, so the design leaves non-clashing metrics alone. Whether the helper also assigns uuids to stored metrics that lack one (which would change them) isn't visible.
The patch does not touch ordering. The author says they did not trace whether the ordering sync keeps the original uuid alongside the new inline one. That sync code is not shown.
Only `update_data[field]` for the inline metric fields is changed. `saved_metrics_ids` is popped and processed as before, and saved metrics are not modified.

The new doc text reads "To reuse a metric across experiments, call `experiment-saved-metrics-create` with the `query`... Do not keep the same metric inline on that experiment as well: remove the inline copy". It does not tell agents to omit the identifier when creating the shared metric. It also does not say to remove the inline metric in the same update that attaches the shared one.

This path is not changed by the patch. It depends on how `seen_metric_uuids` is seeded before `_assign_uuids_to_metrics` on update_data["metrics"]. result:
Inline and shared metrics on an experiment should no longer end up with the same identifier, either through promotion or through a shared-metrics-only update. I haven't run the tests or ruff, and I didn't add a test.

- **Promotion:** in `experiment_saved_metric_service.py`, creating a shared metric now always gives it a new identifier. Before, it kept the identifier of the inline metric it was copied from. This also applies to the legacy-metric migration, which goes through the same code path.
- **Shared-metrics-only update:** in `experiment_service.py`, an update that changes only `saved_metrics_ids` now compares the experiment's stored inline metrics against the newly attached shared metrics. An inline metric that clashes gets a new identifier. I reused the existing `_assign_uuids_to_metrics` helper for this.
- **Agent guidance:** the docs for setting up experiment analytics no longer tell agents to "promote" a metric by creating a shared copy of the same query and then attaching it. They now say to create the shared metric to reuse it and remove the inline copy from that experiment.

- **Ordering not checked:** I didn't confirm that a regenerated identifier lands correctly in the experiment's metric ordering. I expect the existing ordering sync to append it, but I didn't trace that path.
- **Line length:** the new `if` condition in `experiment_service.py` is close to the line limit, so ruff format may wrap it.
